verdict.rationale: PayPal's agentic commerce surface is programmatic by design. It offers OAuth-authenticated REST APIs, a published npm Agent Toolkit for function calling inside agent frameworks, and a self-contained sandbox for testing, all of which can run unattended without a UI. Nothing explicitly documents headless or CI usage, such as CI pipeline guides, non-interactive credential setup for CI, or automation recipes. Access to agentic commerce services is also form-gated rather than self-serve. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI documentation, CI-oriented credential and setup guidance, and hands-on corroboration of running in CI pipelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
